title: Coupon Guideline
content: ### QUESTION 1\. How do I apply a coupon code received from the Marvelous Designer Team? 2\. How can I redeem a coupon issued for my account? ### ANSWER To apply a coupon code: **Step 1.** Log in to our website using your Personal ID. **Step 2.** Go to "My Account" at https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account. **Step 3.** Click on "Coupon List". **Step 4.** Enter your code and save it. **Step 5.** The coupon code will now be available in the list, and you can click on "Apply." *Depending on the coupon type, you will be directed to the checkout process or you will be able to redeem the coupon immediately. ### ### ANSWER To redeem a coupon issued for your account: **Step 1.** Log in to our website using your Personal ID. **Step 2.** Go to "My Account" at [https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account](https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account). **Step 3.** Click on "Coupon List". **Step 4.** If the coupon is available, you will be able to apply it. Depending on the coupon type, you may be directed to the checkout process or be able to redeem the coupon immediately. **Notice: Contest participation coupons are invalid for commercial use.** _Image Reference:_ ![mceclip0.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438533382681) ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438533582233)![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438539614617) ##
content_description: Learn how to easily apply and redeem your coupon codes from the Marvelous Designer Team with our step-by-step guide.

title: How to Renew My License?
content: License renewal procedures vary depending on your **User Type (Personal/Enterprise)** and **Subscription Plan**. Please find your specific plan below for details. ### **👤 Personal Users** License Type | Renewal Method | Details ---|---|--- Personal Monthly | Automatic | Your subscription renews automatically on each billing date. Personal Annual / Student | Manual | These do not renew automatically. You may purchase a new license once your current one has expired. _🔍**Manage Your Subscription:** > To check your next renewal date or manage your settings, go to the **My Account > License** tab._ * * * ### **🏢 Enterprise Users** License Type | Renewal Method | Details ---|---|--- Network Online Monthly | Automatic | This plan renews automatically at the end of each billing cycle. Network Online Annual / Linux Online / Academic | Manual / Contact Sales | These do not renew automatically. Please purchase a new license after expiration or contact your Sales Representative. _🔍**Admin Management:** > To view license status or manage subscriptions, log in with your **Company ID** and navigate to **License Admin Page > License** tab._ * * * **Important Notes:** * For **non-automatic** licenses, please keep track of your expiration date to avoid service interruptions. * If you need to change your payment method for recurring plans, please refer to our guide: [How do I change my payment method for my recurring plans/subscriptions?](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358152417305-How-do-I-change-my-payment-method-for-my-recurring-plans-subscriptions-) * For Enterprise Offline license, please contact our sales team or support team. * Please feel free to ask the sales team about license renewals. For other inquiries, please contact our support team.
content_description: This web page provides detailed license renewal procedures tailored to your User Type and Subscription Plan, ensuring a seamless renewal experience.

title: Enterprise Account & License Management Guide
content: ## Account ### **Company ID - License ID Relationship diagram** ![Company ID.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/55759226352153) _**Difference between License ID and Company ID**_ * _**Company ID:**_ Your "Company ID" is an administrator account that can manage "License IDs" owned by the license manager or purchaser. Through your License Admin Page on our website, you can create, delete and change the password of any "License ID" that belongs to the "Company ID". Purchasing and assigning a license to an "License ID" are authorities only available to a “Company ID”. A “Company ID” cannot contain any type of license on its own and therefore cannot be used to log into the software. * _**License ID:**_ An "License ID" is an account for actual users which can hold licenses and is used to log in to the software. An "License ID" cannot be used to purchase a license through our website. An License ID can only be used to modify some of the information on its account page (i.e. Name, Country, Territory, Region, or Profile Photo) ID Type | **License Purchase** | **License Account Admin Access** | **Store Item Purchase** | **Log In To Software** ---|---|---|---|--- **Company ID** | **O** | **O** | **O** | **X** **License ID** | **X** | **X** | **X** | **O** *** Note** In the case of Enterprise Users who have created their IDs before the deployment of the ‘Company ID - License ID’ structure, you would already have the Company ID designated by us. In order for you to find your Company ID, please [contact us](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/support/contact). ### **How Can I Manage My Licenses?** To manage your licenses, you will first need to login with your Company ID, at the page below. * [Account Login Page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/member/signin) On “License Account Admin” you can view all License IDs you have created, upcoming expiration dates, delete/add users, purchases licenses, view active users, etc. You can access License Account Admin upon after the login, by clicking on your profile icon. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438023097369)![image \(5\).png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437990997657) _(sample image)_ On your “Dashboard”, you can view weekly average access to licenses, how many times licenses were used, how long do users spend on the software on average and etc. _*Denied access_ Denied Access refers to concurrent access being exceeded by users. For example, if you have 10 licenses, your concurrent access will be for 10 seats. If you are sharing the 10 licenses among 20 people, this feature lets you know that one of the 10 individuals will have to log out if another user needs access, or it may be time for you to purchase additional seats. The data is only valid for the network (floating type) license holders. The contact information is also provided on the left bottom of the screen for regional managers. Regional managers can help you with how to use the License Management services, and answer any questions. Based on the location you have set for your account, you will have different regional managers. If the listed regional managers are out of office, please feel free to contact md.bizdev@marvelousdesigner.com to reach out to the entire business development team. ### **How Do I Know What Licenses I Have and What Can I Do With Them?** Click on the “License” tab on your left menu which will bring you to this page. ![image \(6\).png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437977588249) _(sample image)_ **Filter section** In this section, you can search License IDs or an email address to quickly look for the License ID you are looking for, set to view active and expired licenses, perpetual/monthly/yearly/trial licenses and different versions of licenses. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437977795481) _(sample image)_ **License detail section** In this section, you can see every License ID under your Company ID. You can view information such as the email address attached to the License ID, plan type, license type, license count, current software version, and expiration dates. You can also directly add/extend your existing seats, or purchase a new license through this menu option. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438040393497) _(sample image)_ **Add/extend option** You can add another license to the same License ID or extend the license period before the period ends. Both actions can only be done before the license expires. **New license option** New License option allows you to renew licenses past the expiration date. This action can only be done after the license expires. **Trade-In option** Please note that the [trade-in policy](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/support/news/view/f16869c1b54c4ed697f2721cddfe1340) from Enterprise Perpetual licenses to Annual type licenses are no longer available as of Jan 01 2026. **License ID (End User) detail section** Clicking the individual License ID (End User) from the previous image on the left hand side, will lead you to the single License ID detail page. In this page, you can manage License IDs by viewing the user details, your password for the user, the email address and the IP address when the license is being used at corporate premises. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438008453657) _(sample image)_ ### **What Else Can I Expect from License Account Admin page?** **User Pool** Within User Pool feature we provide, licenses are now much flexible in terms of management. Please read a separate manual followed by the link below, for better understanding of the usability around this feature. * [**User Pool Manual**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358149827609) **Invoice** In the invoice section, you can view your past orders and invoices. You can also add and edit your billing address within this section.
content_description: This web page provides essential information and tools for managing Company IDs and License IDs, enabling administrators to oversee licenses, user accounts, and software access efficiently.

title: How to Solve "Error Code 400" Login Failure
content: This article explains how to solve login failures due to "Error Code: 400" and/or "Error Code: 10002". **Technical Background** Starting in March 2024,[ we have integrated the different accounts of users](https://landing.clo-set.com/allatonce) using Marvelous Designer, CLO-SET, and CONNECT into one, and the Marvelous Designer have changed the login via CLO-SET webpage instead of entering ID and password in the login window. This policy will be applied from Marvelous Designer version 2024.0, and previously released Marvelous Designer 7.x or 6.x versions will run by entering ID and password. After the account integration, if the previously-used-user-login-information and the newly-integrated-user-information do not match, or if old-user-information is stored in the web browser being used, the Marvelous Designer login will fail and an error message will be displayed. **Problem Situations** ![error code 400 cropped.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438176217753) * Launched Marvelous Designer, but get an error message instead of logging in. * Successfully logged in to CLO-SET on a web browser, but get an error message. * * * **Causes and Solutions** **In case of security app blocks Marvelous Designer's internet connection** * If an antivirus, firewall, or web monitoring program installed on your computer blocks Marvelous Designer from communicating with the Internet, login will fail. * Change the Internet connection of Marvelous Designer to "Allow" in the detailed settings of your antivirus, firewall, or web monitoring program, and then run the software again. **Marvelous Designer does not have sufficient file read and write permissions** * [Refer to this web post](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358175269657) to grant administrator rights to Marvelous Designer and then run the sofware again. **CLO-SET password error** * [Refer to this article (Q12 & Q13)](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358181484441) to reset your CLO-SET password and then run Marvelous Designer again. **Web browser security policy or web browser cache error** * Web browsers with strict security policies or specific web browsers may have problems accessing the CLO-SET webpage. In this case, try logging in to CLO-SET using the [Chrome browser](https://www.google.com/chrome/browser-tools/). * You may be experiencing problems logging into CLO-SET due to an outdated web browser cache. In this case, clear your cache and try logging in again. This [**saved-search**](https://www.google.com.hk/search?q=how+to+clear+web+browser+cache&oq=how+to+clear+web+browser+cache&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOdIBCDg1OTFqMGoxqAIAsAIA&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8)**** will help. * * * **Read More** * Learn more about[ CLO-SET Account Integration ](https://landing.clo-set.com/allatonce)here. See also[Account Integration User Guide](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358181484441). * If you have followed the steps above but are still unable to log in, please send us your screenshot or error code via [Contact Us](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/support/contact/1).
content_description: This webpage provides solutions for resolving login failures related to "Error Code: 400" and "Error Code: 10002" after the integration of user accounts for Marvelous Designer, CLO-SET, and CONNECT.

title: Edit UV
content: ### Objective Check patterns' UVs before exporting garments and edit UV by shifting pattern locations in the UV Editor (ver2.3.0). ### Location Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ UV Editor (2025.0) Viewport Title Bar ▶ Right-click Dropdown menu ▶ UV Editor (2025.0) Object Browser ▶ UV Editor (up to 2024.2) ![Captura](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438249522713) ### ### Operation #### Manual 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ UV Editor Object Browser ▶ UV Editor → A dotted rectangular guideline appears around all patterns in the UV Editor. 2. Click the icon image at the top-right corner of the guideline. → The guideline icon changes and it becomes available to adjust the UV area manually. → Guidelines display repetitively (ver2.4.0). 3. Click and drag the edge of scale guide to resize the UV area as wanted. 4. Select and shift patterns accordingly. #### Automatic If manually edited by clicking the icon to switch over to automatic. → The dotted rectangular guideline re-appears around all the patterns in the UV Editor.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for checking and editing pattern UVs in the UV Editor before exporting garments in Marvelous Designer.

title: When I try to login, I get the following massage  "Due to a network issue, you are unable to login at this time"
content: Internet access is required for all Marvelous Designer license types with the exception of the Enterprise Network Offline License users. Please try restarting Marvelous Designer, or restart your computer. If you are still facing difficulty logging in, please make sure you do not have a VPN turned on. Offline login is available to Marvelous Designer 5-9 users with a perpetual license. If you need to activate license in offline environment, please refer to this[ manual page](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358427341465)
content_description: This page provides essential troubleshooting steps and guidelines for Marvelous Designer users encountering login issues, particularly regarding internet access and offline licensing.

title: 1:N Free Sewing (2D)
content: Objective Freely establish Sewing Lines on Pattern outlines and Internal Shapes/Lines to sew multiple Patterns to a single Pattern (ver2.2.0). Location Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ Free Sewing 2D Toolbar ▶ Free Sewing Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ Free Sewing 2D Toolbar ▶ Free Sewing 2. Establish the start and the end point on the Pattern outline, which is called as 1, where multiple Patterns are sewn to. 3. Hold down the Shift key on the keyboard. → The Sewing Line appears in neon color. 4. While holding down the Shift key, establish Sewing Lines on N Patterns. Similar to setting regular Free Sewing Lines, be careful with Directional Notches. 5. Release the Shift key to complete. ※ Note * The difference in lengths between the first and second half seams appears in blue next to the mouse cursor. When the difference is greater than 1 inch, it turns red to alert the user. * While establishing 1:N Sewing Lines, if you click on an inappropriate segment, the segment appears in red and the Sewing Line cannot be applied. * While establishing N Sewing Lines, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to cancel the last action or hit the Esc key on the keyboard to cancel all actions.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to freely establish Sewing Lines on pattern outlines and internal shapes for seamless integration of multiple patterns in the Free Sewing operation.

title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Adjust Stretch-Weft/Warp, Shear
content: ### Objective Use the Weft, Warp and Shear intensities to show the resistance against the horizontal, vertical and diagonal elasticity according to the 2D window. Increasing the Shear intensity to the same ratio as the Weft and Warp intensities, is going to express materials that creases easily such as cotton and denim. On the other hand, decreasing the intensity value is going to express more elastic materials such as silk and jersey. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Fabric Property Editor ▶ Physical Property ▶ Detail ▶ Stretch-Weft/Warp, Shear ![sheeer.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438828954265)
content_description: This web page provides guidance on using Weft, Warp, and Shear intensities in the Fabric Property Editor to analyze and manipulate the elasticity of various materials within a 2D window.

title: Styleline Editing
content: ### Objective Quickly shape patterns in the 3D Window, without the need for previous experience in pattern making. * * * ### Location Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ Edit Styleline Tools 3D Window ▶ Edit Styleline Tool Dropdown Menu **** ### Operation 1. Load a garment into a scene with an Avatar. 2. Navigate the tool/menu indicated above under "Location". 3. Select a Styleline Editing Tool: Edit Styleline | Select an edit point or place on a curve to skew the pattern shape dynamically. ---|--- Scale Styleline | Select a pattern edge and scale it as a whole. Move Styleline | Select a pattern edge and move it as singular unit which does not skew. Draw Styleline | Draw a new Styleline onto a pattern in the 3D Window. 1. Click on an edge or corner of a pattern piece to begin drawing a new Styleline across it. 2. Click on in the center of the pattern piece to shape the Styleline. 3. Click on another edge or corner of the pattern piece to complete the new Styleline. 4. Manipulate the new Styleline with any of the other Styleline tools. 4. Alter the garment accordingly and watch the patterns update immediately in both the 3D Window and 2D Pattern Window.
content_description: Easily create and modify 3D garment patterns in real-time, regardless of your prior experience with pattern making.

title: Merge Points on Internal Lines
content: ### Objective Join or merge two open points on Internal Lines. ※ Note: When a point on the Internal Line is open, it is hollow, whereas when a point on the Internal Line is closed, it is filled. ### Location Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern ### Operation #### Join Overlapping Points 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Transform Pattern / Edit Pattern 2. Select overlapping points and right click to access the pop-up menu. Then, select Join Overlapping Points. → Two overlapping points are joined and closed. #### Merge to Point 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern 2. Select two points on Internal Lines to be merged. 3. Right click on the point which the other point should be merged to. When the pop-up menu appears, select Merge to Point. → The point is merged to the right-clicked point. #### Merge to Average 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern 2. Select two points on the Internal Lines to be merged. Then, right click on either point to access the pop-up menu and select Merge to Average. → The selected points are merged to their average point. #### Intersect & Merge 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern 2. Select two points to be merged. 3. Right click on the points to access the pop-up menu and select Intersect & Merge. → The selected points are shortened or extended maintaining their current slope and are merged where they intersect.
content_description: This web page provides detailed instructions for joining or merging open points on Internal Lines in a 2D pattern editing environment.

title: Set Fabric Textures
content: ### Objective Represents the pattern or texture of the fabric. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab ### Operation 1. Click the menu at the indicated location. 2. Select a fabric item. → Fabric properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Set the basic material by referring to the table below. #### PBR (Default) Option | Description ---|--- Texture Repeat Type (Ver. 10) / Texture Mapping (Ver. 11) | Repeat | Repeatedly display the texture on the pattern. Unified Map | Display the texture based on the pattern layout of the UV map. [Repeat UV Settings] * Repeat U: Size the texture based on U direction. * Repeat V: Size the texture based on V direction. The number 1 means that the texture is repeated once between 0-1 of the UV map. Type | Set the appropriate Material Type. ※Note: If garment is created in Marvelous Designer or Downloaded from CONNECT, the fabric type may display as * (Read-only) Fabric Type with the same name in Marvelous Designer. However, since there is no render engine in Marvelous Designer, the fabric display in 3D window will not be accurate. Base Color (ver. 2025.0) | Color | Select your chosen color from the color wheel or leave as (None) Base Color Map | Recolor | Remove the default color to apply other colors while retaining the pattern or texture. Desaturate | It desaturates the color of the graphics. Set the Shadow Intensity and Shadow Brightness. Switch | Easily and quickly switch the color of solid fabric to a new one without losing the accuracy of the chosen color. ![Switch Color.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47358364190105) ※Note: For consistent results, the Base Color Map should contain 1 color. If the Base Color Map contains multiple colors, users may experience unexpected or unintended results. Texture | Click the explore button and apply a texture image from Library/Folder ※Note: Click both back and side tabs and deactivate 'Use Same Materials as Front' to apply different materials to other faces of the pattern. Remove Texture Color | Remove the default color to apply other colors while retaining the pattern or texture. Normal Map | Apply Normal Map image to express uneven texture more realistically. Automatic | When a texture is applied, Normal Map is generated by adjusting the Intensity. Higher intensity makes the embossed detail raised off the surface, the lower intensity makes the details lower than the surface. Manual | Click the explore or apply the Normal Map image from the Library/Folder ※Note: Use the normal map image made with the exclusive tool to achieve an accurate normal effect. Also, add a normal map that is different with texture in order to create an extra pattern of surface. Displacement Map (ver.11) | Express thickness or bumpiness of fabrics or textures. As displacement maps are grey-scaled, their height is determined by the level of darkness of the grey color. ※ Note: * Increase the image resolution and apply the Gaussian Blur effect to express the texture smoothly. * Displacement map's minimum particle distance value is now 0.01 mm to allow for greater mesh density for displacement map (Ver. 2024.1) Amount | Adjust the maximum height of the displacement map. The white area of the displacement map shows the maximum height. Shift | Adjust the distance between the displacement map and the garment surface Clipping | Adjust to delete all geometries below the Clipping value. Particle Distance | Adjust the Particle Distance of newly created meshes. ※ Note: As more memory is used for lower Particle Distance, it is recommended not to set the Particle Distance below 1 for a wide area. Keep Continuity | Extend the adjacent face to eliminate the boundary line. ※ Note: Only applicable to Welded OBJs. Color | Express each of the fabrics in various colorways Opacity | Adjust Opacity to create sheer fabric. ※Note: When you apply opacity to texture, change Garment Rendering Style as Thick Textured Surface. Alpha Map (ver. 10) | Express level of transparency using a grayscale image map RGB Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in RGB channel. Alpha Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in alpha channel. Roughness | Intensity | Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness Map | Edit fabric gloss by adding and modifying Roughness Map. Map | Select the Browse button next to the Map option to add a Roughness Map to the selected Fabric style. Map Intensity | Adjust the Map's Intensity. The range of Roughness map intensity was enlarged in (ver. 2024.2) Invert | Select to invert the gloss of the fabric. When this option is selected, the shinny part becomes dull and vice-versa. To use Specular Maps provided in below ver. 6, check this option. Reflection Intensity | Greater the Reflection Intensity value is, more reflective than the material or fabric is and vice-versa. Metalness (ver. 10) | Adjust metallic level. Higher value makes the surface more metallic. Metalness Map (ver. 10) | Partially express metallics using a grayscale image. The white parts of the map appear metallic. ※Note: * When working with Metalness Map, control Roughness Intensity and Reflection Intensity level that are suitable for the metallic texture. (e.g. Roughness Intensity 10, Reflection Intensity 90) * For the non-metallic areas(matte), assign the same metalness map to Roughness Map, and turn on Invert. #### Substance (ver. 10) Set the file format as Substance at the right menu of Material, you can use SBSAR file of Substance which is the main application of physical based rendering. To get a better rendering result for substance materials, enable High-Quality Render on 3D window. Properties | Description ---|--- Substance File | Import SBSAR file by clicking 'Explore' or, download SBSAR file by clicking 'Go to Substance Source'. * SBSAR file can be imported by Object Browser> Right-click on Fabric item. Preset | Choose the preset of SBSAR. Resolution | Adjust the image resolution of SBSAR. Custom Properties | Edit the properties of SBSAR. ※Note: Custom Properties are different depending on the property of the file. Refer to the [Substance Manual](https://docs.substance3d.com/home) for more detailed information. ※ Note: * Clicking on a Fabric from the Fabric List is going to highlight the Patterns where the Fabric is being applied to, in the 3D/2D window. * Clicking on a Pattern in the 3D or 2D window is going to highlight the Fabric where it is being applied to, in the Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for selecting and customizing fabric patterns and textures within the Object Browser's Fabric Tab, ensuring users can effectively manipulate material properties for enhanced 3D rendering.

title: Why do I have to pay tax?
content: **Question** I am VAT registered. Why do I have to pay tax? **Answer** Please note that if you have a correct registered VAT ID, you can add VAT ID on Billing Address and your tax will be waived Since January 2019, CLO Virtual Fashion LLC(Marvelous Designer US office) has officially been registered VAT MOSS(Sales Tax) in Ireland(EU). \- Since our online license sales are handled by our US office, all of our Individual license pricing will be in effect, according to the regulation below. From January 2015, new legislation came into force that affects the sale of digital services to customers in other EU countries. Digital services include broadcasting, telecommunications, and electronic services(which includes software products). The VAT rate that is calculated for this type of transaction is based on a place of supply the service. The legislation that is regulating MOSS rules is: * [Council Directive (EU) 2017/2455](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=CELEX:32017L2455&from=EN) \- supplies of services and distance sales of goods (VAT e-commerce package). * [Council Directive 2008/8/EC](http://eur-lex.europa.eu/LexUriServ/LexUriServ.do?uri=OJ:L:2008:044:0011:0022:EN:PDF) \- a place of supply of services. * [Council Implementing Regulation (EU) No 1042/2013](http://eur-lex.europa.eu/LexUriServ/LexUriServ.do?uri=OJ:L:2013:284:0001:0009:EN:PDF) \- place of supply of services. This means if your billing address is under the EU region, VAT rates for each country will be added to your purchase. Austria | 20% ---|--- Belgium | 21% Bulgaria | 20% Czech Republic | 21% Denmark | 25% Germany | 19% Estonia | 20% Ireland | 23% Greece | 24% Spain | 21% France | 20% Croatia | 25% Italy | 22% Cyprus | 19% Latvia | 21% Lithuania | 21% Luxembourg | 17% Hungary | 27% Malta | 18% Netherlands | 21% Poland | 23% Portugal | 23% Romania | 19% Slovenia | 22% Slovakia | 20% Finland | 24% Sweden | 25% UK | 20% If you would like to discover more regarding VAT MOSS, please review the file attached.
content_description: This web page provides essential information on VAT regulations for VAT-registered customers and explains how to waive applicable taxes by adding a valid VAT ID during the billing process.

title: Marvelous Designer File Format
content: ### Marvelous Designer File Format Type | Format | Description ---|---|--- Garment | [*.zpac](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358279381529) | Contains information on Garments, Patterns, Sewing, and Fabrics. Project | [*.zprj](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358219651225) | Compresses the various files used for Garment creation into one file, and saves it. The Project file contains the AVT file that has Avatar-related data [Avatar, Accessories, Arrangement Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points, Avatar size, Poses] and the ZPac file that contains Garment-related data [3D Garments, 2D Patterns, Fabrics, subsidiary Material], as well as an animation file if there is animation. Avatar | [*.avt](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358359735961) | Contains all the information related to Avatars (Model, Sizing data, Poses, Motions, Accessories, Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points). Avatar (Encrypted) | [*.avte](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358187017113) | Encrypted MD/CLO avatar file types. This file type cannot be exported,[ This includes the Metahuman Body Types found in the Avatar folders. ](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358187017113) Pose | [*.pos](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358350508697) | Avatar Pose information that, automatically saved whenever the Garment is saved. The Avatar’s Pose can easily be changed with this file. Avatar Poses from other software can only be saved when the Avatar is a COLLADA file with joints. Joint Motion | [*.mtn](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358363172249) | Contains Avatar Motion information. As with the Pose file, can only be saved on COLLADA file Avatars with joint and Animation information. Fabric | [*.zfab](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358267968153) | Contains the property values (texture + physical properties) of the set Fabric. Physical Property | [*.psp](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358434392857) | Contains the detailed values of Fabric Physical Properties. Topstitch | [*.sst](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358389918873) | Contains the type, number of lines, thread thickness, SPI, length, etc. Button | [*.btn](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358452715161) | Contains the type, size, and color of Buttons. Buttonhole | [*.bth](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358452715161) | Contains the tyle, size, and color of the Buttonholes. Arrangement Point | [*.arr](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358280634905) | Arrangement Points are the blue points that are distributed around the Avatar, and are used to arrange Patterns easily around the Avatar. Arrangement Points are created on top of the Arrangement Bounding Volume covering the surroundings of the Avatar. Arrangement Bounding Volume | [*.pan](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358365447705) | Arrangement Bounding Volumes are the green cylinders covering each part of the Avatar, and each end of a cylinder is connected to an Avatar’s joint. As such, even if the Avatar’s Pose is changed, the cylinder simply adjusts to the changed Pose and can be used as it is. Tape Measure | *.mea | It has the information of the tape measure created in the avatar. Camera Projection | *.cmp | Contains the camera's Field of View information (near, far, etc.). Camera Transformation | *.cmt | Contains camera view information of the 3D Garment window. Simulation Property | [*.smp](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358232630937) | Contains settings for Simulation.
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide to the various file formats used in Marvelous Designer, detailing their functions and contents for garment creation and avatar management.

title: ZIPPER: Create Zippers
content: ### Objective Create and use Zippers quickly and easily. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Zipper ▶ Zipper 3D Toolbar ▶ Zipper ### Operation 1. Navigate to the location listed below: 3D Toolbar ▶ Zipper 2. Click on the 3D garment or 2D Patterns (ver MD10) where the Zipper should be attached, then move the cursor. → Based on the direction the cursor is moved, the segment where the Zipper appears is highlighted in light blue. 3. Double click on the desired endpoint for the Zipper. → One side of the Zipper is created. 4. Click on the Pattern outline where the other side of the Zipper is attached, then move the cursor. → Based on the direction the cursor is moved, a blue point appears indicating the same length as the first half of the Zipper which was created in step 3. 5. Double click on the blue point. → The Zipper is now complete, along with a Puller, Slider, and Stopper (ver MD10). 6. Activate the Simulation. → The Zipper simulates in a closed/fully zipped state. → To unzip the Zipper, click on the Zipper in the 3D Window WITHOUT the Gizmo active, and drag to move the Zipper (referenced in dark grey) along the length of the Zipper Tape. ※ Note: #### Cancel Actions during Zipper Creation * Cancel All Actions While using the Zipper tool, press 'Esc' or 'Ctlr +Z' on the keyboard, and all actions will be undone. * Cancel Last Action While using the Zipper tool, press the 'Delete' or 'Backspace' Key on the keyboard and the last action will be undone.
content_description: Easily create and simulate zippers for 3D garments and 2D patterns using our streamlined Zipper tool.

title: Fold Pattern
content: ### Objective Use this function to create a pressing effect by adjusting the angle of Pattern's Internal Line, for instance, pressed lines of formal trousers, fold direction of pleats. ### Location Pattern Property Editor ▶ Fold ▶ Fold Angle ### Operation 1. Click on an Internal Line with Transform Pattern or Edit Pattern. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Pattern Property Editor ▶ Fold ▶ Fold Angle 3. Adjust the value of Fold Angle as desired. ※ Note: Fold Strength | Sets the angle closer as the value increases. The value range is in between 0 to 20. ---|--- Fold Angle | Sets the value in the range of 0˚ to 360˚, 180˚ represents a flat state. The internal line is folded towards the front of the pattern as the fold angle is closer to 0˚, and is folded into the back of the pattern as the angle is closer to 360˚. Fold Rendering | Sets whether the pleats to have soft or sharp edges according to user preference. (Only applicable if Fold Arrangement is used on an Internal line.)
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for creating a pressing effect on patterns by adjusting the Fold Angle and Fold Strength in the Pattern Property Editor.

title: Fold/Sew Pleats
content: ### ### ### ### Objective Create a variety of pleats, fold and sew them (ver2.3.0). ### Location Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Pleats ▶ Pleats Fold / Pleats Sewing 2D Toolbar ▶ Pleats Fold / Pleats Sewing ### Operation #### Pleats Fold 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Pleats ▶ Pleats Fold 2D Toolbar ▶ Pleats Fold 2. Click to establish the initial point for the direction of the pleats, then double-click to establish the end point. → Pleats Fold window appears. 3. Select a desired type of pleats. → Depending on the selected pleats type, the Fold Angles of the Internal Lines are now being highlighted. ※ Note: Yellow: Outside fold line (Fold angle of zero(0) degree), Light-blue: Inside fold line (Fold angle of 360 degree), Not highlighted: No fold line (Fold angle of 180 degree) 4. Check Reverse Direction option as needed. → The direction of pleats being folded are now being reversed. 5. Click OK button to complete. #### Pleats Sewing 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Pleats ▶ Pleats Sewing 2D Toolbar ▶ Pleats Sewing 2. Click on the initial point and drag up to the end point of the seamline on the pleats Pattern. 3. On the pleats Pattern, click on the first Sewing Line to begin with, and move the mouse to the end point. → Sewing is now being established for every three(3) segments (the amount of segments needed to create each individual pleat). 4. Click on the end point to complete. → The color of the fluorescent sewing lines are now being changed for respective seam color, indicating that the sewing is being completed.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for creating, folding, and sewing various types of pleats in 2D patterns using our software.
